title: Protocol Review by Anee: A Second Pair of Eyes on Your Crop Plan
metaTitle: Protocol Review by Anee: Check Your Crop Plan First
metaDescription: Protocol review by Anee: she reads every task of your crop protocol against the growth stages, scores it out of 100 and says what to fix before you plant.
excerpt: A mistake in the plan costs nothing while it is still on paper. In a protocol review, Anee reads the crop protocol you wrote in the anee.io Protocol Builder, task by task. She scores it and says what is good, what is missing and what could go wrong. Then she suggests the tasks to add.

heroImage.alt: A rice protocol in the anee.io Protocol Builder with tasks on the DAS count and the Analyses tab where each protocol review is kept

blocks.text: What Anee checks in a protocol review

Tap Analyze by Anee at the top of a protocol. She reads the version you are using, with every task on its day count and the materials and rates in each. Your notes and phase dividers count too. Then she sets it all against the growth stage table anee.io keeps for that crop.

items: **Coverage**: land preparation, planting, water, nutrition by stage, weed, pest and disease control, monitoring and harvest
**Timing**: tasks that come too early, too late or out of order for the crop's stage
**Products and rates**: the wrong product for the job, a tank mix that must not be made, too much or too little
**Safety**: the waiting days between the last spray and harvest, when workers may go back into a sprayed field, and anything else that puts the crop or the worker at risk
A score out of 100 and a short verdict, like solid but thin on weed control
What is good, with the reason
What is missing or weak, why it matters and the fix
What could go wrong, on which days, and what to do about it
A mark on every task: good, check or concern, with a short note
Tasks Anee would add, each on its day count, ready to add with one tap
A note on the order and spacing of the tasks, and a short summary to act on

blocks.text:
The marks also show on the task cards, so you can scroll your plan and find every concern. When you add one of her tasks, it lands on its day count with her reason in its note. That way you still remember why it is there next season.

The score is honest. A protocol with only two tasks cannot score high, however good those two are.
Every protocol review stays on the Analyses tab

The protocol's Analyses tab keeps each run, newest first, with the version it read and the credits it used. So you can run a review, change the plan, run another and open the older one to see what moved. Keep one version for the wet season and one for the dry, and review each.

Want to ask more? Open a review and tap Ask Anee about it. A chat opens with the review attached, so she can explain a gap or suggest another product for your area. It works like any question to [Anee, the AI agricultural technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician).
The review and the builder's own warnings

The [Protocol Builder](/features/protocol-builder) already warns you as you write. For example, it flags two sprays on one day or a spray within 14 days of harvest. Those checks are free and instant. The review goes further, because Anee reads the whole season as an agronomist would, including what is not there yet.

No protocol yet? Let the [Crop Protocol Analysis](/features/crop-protocol-analysis) write a first plan by growth stage. Then write your own in the builder and ask for a review before day zero.

Anee flags rates that look too high or too low, but the season's fertilizer is still yours to work out. Our guide to [fertilizer calculation](/blog/fertilizer-calculation) turns a recommendation into bags for your area. [Fertilizer for rice](/blog/fertilizer-for-rice) lists the usual timing of each split, top dressing fertilizer included. For sprays, use only products registered with the [Fertilizer and Pesticide Authority](/blog/fertilizer-and-pesticide-authority), and follow the label.

The review also reads your Materials tab, with how much of each input you have on hand. If the tasks call for more, she sees the shortfall. Once the season runs, the [farm inventory](/features/farm-inventory-and-expenses) on Solo Farmer and Farm Owner keeps count of what you buy and use.

blocks.title: Runs on credits
blocks.text: The review comes with Libre plus Anee, Solo Farmer and Farm Owner. Its sheet shows the price and your balance, and no credits come off until you tap Analyze it. Removing a review from the tab does not return its credits. The Protocol Builder itself is free on every plan.

items.q: Can I review an older version?
items.a: Anee reads the version in use. Switch to the version you want, then run the review, and each review notes the version it read.
Yes. Every run stays on the Analyses tab until you remove it.
